text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The new year has begun, and starting this 
year, <chrname> enters the Senior class.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after wrapping up her first attempt, 
her number of supporters hasn't wavered. 
Expectations remain high for the next 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With our eyes set on the Representative 
Exchange Race in late March, the days of 
training begin. This year, I will make 
everyone's expectations—and their dream—a 
reality.
